motivation: Y023 identified collision-induced matching deficiencies and radius-two rescue. Now test whether nine bounded retained memory slots reduce recurrent assignment disruption across an eight-episode shifting-collision sequence.
hypothesis: A strictly bounded prior-placement cache (9 retained slots) can reduce repeat-key assignment churn against deterministic stateless radius-two matching, while both keep the same seven active keys and 16 total cell/key identities.
freeze: All seeds, episodes, matching order, cache size, collisions, evaluation, and metrics frozen before first execution. No post-outcome mutation, threshold fitting, or retry.
world: 16 circular cells and 16 motif identities; exactly 7 currently active motifs and at most 9 inactive remembered assignments, radius two. Home(key,seed,episode)=(7*key+seed+episode) mod 16 before a deterministic four-way collision among the first four active keys.
active_keys: For seed and episode, keys [(3*seed+2*episode+5*j) mod16, j=0..6], each unique.
arms: Stateless: deterministic augmenting-path maximum matching from scratch; evaluator may score historical churn but policy cannot read history
Retained: preserve legal cached assignments first, complete via the same augmenting-path routine, update fixed 9-slot least-recently-used cache only from current observed assignments
metric: Per-episode active assignment cardinality, returning-key assignment churn, and matching-search calls; report per-seed cumulative churn and memory writes. Both arms have 7 active/9 reserved slots with no extra motifs or cells.
classification: RETAINED_STATE_REDUCES_CHURN if every heldout seed has equal cardinality and the heldout total memory churn is lower with no failed matching; MIXED if some seeds improve and some worsen; NO_RETENTION_GAIN otherwise. INVALID if matching legality, bounds, determinism, or source identity fails.
validation: Exact predecessor and immutable prereg/source blobs, legal matching and bounded memory invariants, deterministic replay, first-use archive, full repo regression.
claim_limit: Synthetic recurrent placement memory; not learned semantic consolidation, cognitive regeneration, or real-world transfer.
